mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper provides phenotypic antibiofilm evidence against C. albicans 17-88, with Table 3 and Fig. 1 reporting biofilm formation and preformed-biofilm inhibition endpoints.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Phenotypic antibiofilm activity is not by itself a molecular target assignment.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: SEM evidence supports direct fungal cell surface/cell wall damage after RP554 exposure, consistent with membrane/cell-wall perturbation; this is bounded to morphology and does not prove a single molecular target.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: RP554 as representative dAMP in SEM experiments
mechanism_claims.limitations: The primary source uses SEM morphology; no receptor/enzyme target or binding constant is reported in local material.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The rat vulvovaginal candidiasis model supports in vivo efficacy and local safety observations for topical dAMP treatment, but this is efficacy context rather than a direct mechanism assay.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: topical RP504/RP554/RP557 in rat VVC model
mechanism_claims.limitations: Figure-level CFU values are graphical/local-image values; exact per-group CFU numbers beyond the textual significance claims are not fabricated.
